neighbours.label: The word-final piece (-ner, -ler, -er, -ainer) that completes a surname the tokenizer splits (Ray|ner, Find|ler, Wall|er); surnames that are a single token (Miller, Turner, Wagner) and ordinary -er words stay quiet.
fire: The second symphony by Gustav Mahler was performed last night.
Our new cardiology chief, Dr. Anna Brenner, starts on Monday.
A study by Fiedler and two colleagues found no effect.
The motion was filed on Friday by attorney Sam Wexler.
In 1918 Oswald Spengler wrote about the decline of the West.
The Swiss naturalist Conrad Gessner catalogued the animals of Europe.
For four decades the Hausler family ran the village bakery.
After the war Erich Kahler taught at Princeton.
quiet: The famous overture by Richard Wagner was performed last night.
Our new oncology chief, Dr. Anna Turner, starts on Monday.
A survey by Walker and two colleagues found no effect.
On Friday attorney Sam Parker filed the motion.
In 1918 a German historian wrote about the decline of the West.
The Swiss naturalist catalogued the animals of Europe in five volumes.
For four decades the Butler family ran the village bakery.
After the war the professor taught at Princeton.
